data.exact_reserve_text: Change in estimates of prior year provisions (5,786)

named_events.loss_description: a series of devastating wildfires started in Los Angeles, which quickly spiralled out of control due to drought conditions and strong winds. The event is expected to trigger material losses to Syndicate 6117 and considering the uncertainty involved, a reliable estimate of the associated outflows cannot be made. However, this is not expected to impact the going concern of Syndicate 6117. As the event occurred after the balance sheet date, the technical provisions included in these financial statements do not contain any estimates in relation to the wildfires.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a release of GBP 5.786 million in prior year reserves, primarily due to favourable claims development. This improvement was observed in the 2021 and 2022 underwriting years, particularly within longer tail and Specialty classes.
raw_causal_phrases: improvement in its prior year reserves for 2021 & 2022, due to good experience on its longer tail and Specialty classes
data.data_quality_notes: The claims development triangle on page 15 could not be used to calculate prior year development as it only covers the current and two most recent underwriting years, and a previous report's triangle is needed for comparison. The prior year development figure is taken from the 'Technical Provisions' note which explicitly states 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions'.
